verdict.rationale: Docs confirm core on-call building blocks — schedules that map coverage needs, escalation policies linking services to schedules, and identifying who is on call and when (pagerduty-docs-12, pagerduty-docs-7, pagerduty-docs-44) — plus a Shift Agent that monitors calendars and coordinates schedule changes (pagerduty-docs-58). However, no evidence explicitly documents rotation layers, time-zone handling, or round-robin coverage patterns as named features. missing for 10: explicit documentation of schedule layers, time-zone-aware rotations, and round-robin distribution logic.
